limitations: Uniformly nondegenerate Bernoulli probabilities and a fixed large-deviation separation from the mean are required. The first-order remainder is conservative and no complete heterogeneous expansion is claimed. The explicit heterogeneity constant is not asserted optimal. Sparse, moderate-deviation, dependent, and near-the-mean regimes are outside the result. General saddlepoint theory may recover part of the first theorem by specialization; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: Precise stop-loss large deviations for Poisson-binomial sums
